ask: can u make a signup sheet for door, music, and cleanup shifts
sentence: A shared signup sheet where chat members take or leave limited-capacity time slots for door, music and cleanup shifts at an event.
use_when: People need to sign up for volunteer shifts at an event
A group wants to fill roles with a set number of spots per time slot
You want to see who is on each shift and which spots are still open
dont_use_when: The group needs to pick one date or time by voting
Tasks need to be assigned by one person rather than chosen by each member
People need to split costs or track who owes money
